subject: Scaling perception data pipelines // learnings from Skydio & Zipline
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw the recent raise (congrats!) - also noticed your targets to launch in
40 new US bases + hit 2M deliveries - so thought it would be worth a quick
intro as you scale the perception / autonomy stack.

For context, Encord works with leading Physical AI teams including Skydio &
Zipline - providing the platform + services to scale their multimodal
annotation pipelines.

Would be great to be introduced & happy to share how we may be able to
support you as you scale to new environments.

Would you be open to having a quick chat early next week?

subject: Scaling multimodal annotation pipelines // learnings from Skydio & Scout AI
text:

subject: HumanX - Dinner invite 7th April
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed you're heading to HumanX next week - would love to invite you to a
intimate AI leaders dinner we're hosting on Tues, Apr 7 alongside the
conference.

Confirmed are VPs and C-suite from Microsoft, Miro, Thinking Machine Labs,
Nike and more.

For context, Encord just raised our Series C - we're a multimodal ML
DataOps platform helping enterprises align AI systems with the right data
so they perform reliably, often for customer-facing features like chatbots.

The dinner will be a short walk from Moscone, with ~20 CxOs and founders
joining from frontier labs, creative studios, and enterprises - my
co-founder, [SENDER], will be there and would really enjoy connecting.

Can I save you a seat? Happy to share details.

subject: Coffee at AI Engineer Europe
text:

week. Would you have 15/20 mins to grab a coffee with our senior leadership

Let me know a time which works best for you if this is of interest.
